Our state law also requires the immediate removal of any elector who does not vote for the presidential candidate of the party that nominated the elector. Section 47 of the Michigan Election Law (MCL 168.47) says, “Refusal or failure to vote for the candidates for president and vice-president appearing on the Michigan ballot of the political party which nominated the elector constitutes a resignation from the office of elector, his vote shall not be recorded and the remaining electors shall forthwith fill the vacancy.”

Please be assured that we are watching the process carefully and will do everything we can to ensure our election laws are followed. That is why a Joint House and Senate Oversight Committee met last Saturday to subpoena records and compel testimony. This is about ensuring the integrity of our elections and making sure that all legal votes count, no one is disenfranchised, and anyone who violates our elections laws will be prosecuted.
